retrain_triggers.queue_precision_floor: precision@50 of last month's queue (once outcomes arrive) < base rate + 0.05 for 2 months in a row
retrain_triggers.base_rate_shift: monthly share of declining pages moves > 10 points vs training (0.54)
retrain_triggers.feature_drift: PSI > 0.25 on any monitored traffic feature (age excluded: it shifts by design)
retrain_triggers.new_client: a client with no history in training -> score separately, review 100% of its first queue
retrain_triggers.search_event: a known search-engine core update or tracking change -> pause queue, re-validate before use
retrain_triggers.schedule: retrain monthly on the newest 90-day window; re-run w06 audit before replacing the model
